newsitem.title: USA: Carrington in talks to repurchase shrs.
newsitem.headline: Carrington in talks to repurchase shrs.

text.p: Carrington Laboratories Inc said Thursday that it is in final negotiations with the holders of its Series E convertible preferred stock to repurchase the balance of its outstanding preferred shares.
The total cost of the repurchase is expected to be about $3,872,000, Carrington said.
The company said it expects to close the transaction on or about May 21.

The company's preferred shares have a conversion value of $3.3 million and may be converted at 87 percent of the market price of the company's common stock calculated over a three-day trading period prior to conversion, the company said.
